metadata.chapter_subtitle: Vortex dynamics and damage assessment from rotating thunderstorms

inventory.summary: The tornado chapter was technically rich but needed clearer onboarding so vorticity, stretching, and damage-rating logic were established before the more advanced vortex math.
issues: The chapter lacked a learner-facing setup block.
The conceptual bridge from storm-scale rotation to tornado intensity needed earlier framing.
There was one escaped-currency glitch in the practical mitigation note.

rewrite.summary: Added stronger chapter-entry framing and repaired a minor notation glitch while preserving the vortex and EF-scale modelling.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start section.
Used the opening to emphasize concentration and stretching of rotation.
Repaired the escaped-currency line in the shelter-cost note.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces the tornado problem more fairly while preserving mathematically coherent vorticity and vortex treatments.

repair.summary: The repair was primarily pedagogical, with one small notation cleanup.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Clarified the link between mesocyclone rotation and tornado intensification.

design_review.summary: The chapter's existing visuals and examples remain effective, and the revised entry improves how readers interpret them.
improvements_made: Added learner-facing prerequisites and focus guidance.
Preserved the chapter's strong vortex and damage-rating support.
Improved interpretive support around the concentration-of-rotation idea.
